summary: sextant-cli-darwin-arm64 ships a prebuilt binary implementing a remote-controlled PTY backdoor and Anthropic credential harvest
details: The npm package ships a prebuilt Go binary at bin/sxt that links a PTY library (github.com/creack/pty), a WebSocket client (github.com/coder/websocket), and pion/webrtc, and contains the hardcoded destinations wss://relay.sextant.top and https://relay.sextant.top/install. The websocket-to-PTY dataflow gives a remote party at the hardcoded relay interactive shell access on the installer's host. The same binary embeds the Anthropic API key regex `sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}` alongside the string `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=` and a reference to https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models, indicating that installer-owned Anthropic credentials are identified and handled by the same binary that maintains the remote channel. The binary additionally queries http://ip-api.com/json/ for public IP, city, ISP, ASN, and hosting/proxy status of the installer host. package.json declares `"license": "SEE LICENSE IN https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control"`, tying the artifact to a repository named `claude_control` under the account `ddos798`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
